_comment: Runtime untested. Build and publication only; no game server was started.
name: Renegade X
author: draakoor@users.noreply.github.com
description: Renegade X multiplayer under Wine (Linux/amd64). Explicit installation through the official TA patcher. No automatic updates on startup. Runtime, join, RCON and shutdown have not been tested. See the repository README before use.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Displayed server name. No control characters, double quotes or backslashes.

variables.name: Starting map
variables.description: Installed map name without extension. Map rotation remains in game/UDKGame/Config/UDKGame.ini.

variables.name: Maximum players
variables.description: Player limit. Capacity and performance have not been measured.

variables.name: Steam query port
variables.description: Assign this UDP port as an additional allocation. Must differ from game and RCON ports.

variables.name: Internal RCON port
variables.description: TCP port used by the native console bridge. Do not assign a public allocation for it. Must differ from other ports.

variables.name: Administrator password
variables.description: Required for native RCON and in-game administration. Use 12-128 characters: letters, numbers and _.@%+=:,!-. No default password.

variables.name: Game password
variables.description: Optional join password. Empty allows joining without a password. Allowed: letters, numbers and _.@%+=:,!-.
